thread:
emily (sales): Heads-up — Spectra (fintech scaleup) just asked us to onboard an open model they want to use for their EU pilot: `spectra-lm-13b-v3.1`. Requirements: version pinning, private deployment in eu-west, KMS-managed keys, 99.9% uptime SLA. They said they'd sign a reserved capacity commit if we can meet latency target: <100ms for 256 tokens (p95). HF link: https://huggingface.co/spectra/spectra-lm-13b-v3.1

nate (product): Adding to intake queue. Can someone check legal + infra blockers? Do we treat this as P1 (enterprise pilot / likely ARR)?

riju (eng-ml): I'll take perf/quant work. Quick notes: model seems to be FP16 trained; int8/4 quant might be feasible but will need a quality regression check. I can run a perf smoke on our 80A pool. Need a copy of weights or read access to HF repo.

emily (sales): They can grant HF read access and will share a small sample dataset. License page on HF says MIT but please confirm. Also they want private VPC, not public-hosted.

samir (legal): I'll triage license + export control. MIT is permissive but we need to confirm training data provenance and any third-party content. Also checking EAR/OFAC flags for the model weights — will report back EOD.

david (infra): Capacity note: eu-west is currently near 85% utilized on inference pools. If they want reserved capacity we can carve a pool, but need QPS and concurrency numbers. KMS + VPC peering is supported but provisioning lead time ~2-3 days once ticketed.

lana (solutions): I can collect their expected QPS and sample prompts. If tail latency can't meet the SLA we can offer a fallback to `redwood-fast-13b-quant` as a stopgap while we optimize.

nate (product): Proposed launch criteria (pre-launch):
1) Legal signoff on license & export control
2) Perf: p50/p95 for 256 tokens within SLA (<100ms target; fallback p95 <150ms)
3) Automated rollback + canary deployment configured
4) Customer prompt eval set passed (quality regression <= 2% vs baseline)
5) Cost estimate and reserved pricing term agreed
If all good, move to backlog for implementation.

riju (eng-ml): Plan for perf smoke:
```bash
# download weights
hf_hub_download --repo_id spectra/spectra-lm-13b-v3.1 --filename model.pt
# run perf smoke (256 tokens, warm cache)
python perf_smoke.py --model ./model.pt --seq_len 256 --iters 300 --batch 1
```
I'll try bitsandbytes int8 then int4 quant to see perf/quality tradeoffs. Will push a quick evaluation report.

david (infra): Ops checklist: VPC peering + private endpoints, KMS integration, dedicated GPU pool (estimate: 2x A100 or 4x 80A depending on qps), RBAC for customer keys. Need a ticket with target start date to schedule.

samir (legal): Initial export control check: models > 7B sometimes have additional controls in some jurisdictions. I'm escalating to security/CISO for quick sign-off. If negative, we'll need to route to Private product + legal approval.

emily (sales): Customer requests ETA by Friday EOD for pilot start. Can we promise?

nate (product): Realistically: perf + legal smoke = 2 business days; infra provisioning + canary = additional 3-5 business days post-approval. So promise earliest 5-7 business days after we get weights + signed MSA addendum. Mark as P1 for now. Owners: riju (perf), samir (legal), david (infra), lana (customer comms). I'll create the product ticket.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RED-5678 for Spectra model onboarding (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5678)

lana (solutions): I'll draft a short MSA addendum and SLO sheet to capture the 99.9% request and latency targets; will ask them for 5-10 representative prompts and a traffic sample (qps, concurrency).

emily (sales): Sending request now with HF link + sample prompts. Will cc @lana.

nate (product): Decision points for backlog: 1) treat as standalone catalog entry (model variant + pinned version) or 2) onboard as customer-private variant (if license or training data concerns). Product prefers catalog entry with pinned version if legal clearance.

riju (eng-ml): Quick perf note: if int4 looks unstable we may have to run int8 with KV cache optimization; that will change capacity estimate. Will report numbers in RED-5678.

david (infra): Also note: if they want KMS in their tenant, we'll need IAM mapping. Ops time + runbook update required.

samir (legal): I'll post final legal signoff in the ticket when complete. ETA EOD today for preliminary guidance.

lana (solutions): +1 on sample prompts and traffic. I'll draft onboarding doc for them (SLA, rollback plan, endpoints).

emily (sales): Customer asked about region fallback: they prefer eu-west but can accept eu-central as fallback if latency comparable. I'll note that.

nate (product): OK — next steps: riju run perf smoke, samir final legal check, david confirm capacity estimate and tentative pool size, lana gather prompts + traffic. I'll convert this thread into RED-5678 tasks and prioritize accordingly. :thumbsup:
